freeze_boundary: Freeze final analysis plan, implementations, declared240 model roster and complete training analysis before official C/D generation. No formal fresh events have been used to design these analyses.

catalogs.analysis: Report each catalog separately; no primary pooling or cross-catalog selection.
catalogs.coverage_scope: 95% families apply separately per catalog; not joint95% coverage over both catalogs.

primary_estimand.overall: mean of g_i over S1 eligible events in the fixed launched-stratum design
primary_estimand.model_scope: Fixed already-trained and selected checkpoints; source-validation selection happened before fresh generation.

contrast_direction: Every interaction is more-information gain minus less-information gain; no monotonic direction assumed.

bootstrap.method: Exact paired nonparametric multinomial within each of42 fixed launched strata.
bootstrap.stratum_definition: 7 fixed p bins x3 thicknesses x2 charges, as catalog group_id.
bootstrap.null_atom: For stratum g, each eligible event has probability1/n_launched,g; merge all physical S0 events into one atom with probability n_ineligible,g/n_launched,g and zero score numerator / zero eligibility denominator. Technical failures are not S0 and prevent COMPLETE status.
bootstrap.denominator: For each replicate sum eligible weighted scores divided by total weighted S1 count; each group divides by its own weighted S1 count.
bootstrap.pairing: One draw per stratum/replicate is shared by all models, seeds, primary gains and derived contrasts. Independent RNG streams spawned per stratum from fixed master seed.
uncertainty_included: finite event sampling conditional on fixed models and simulator settings
eligible-rate and across-stratum eligible-mixture variation at fixed launched counts
uncertainty_excluded: new physics list, geometry, parameter, or transport-model uncertainty
unknown serial dependence in a pseudorandom stream
bootstrap.intervals: Report pointwise95% percentile intervals and centered max-absolute-t simultaneous bands. Standardization uses bootstrap SD of each coordinate; max-t95th percentile uses all supplied contrasts. Deterministic coordinates receive zero width. Approximate bootstrap coverage, not an exact finite-sample guarantee.
bootstrap.group_families: For eight primary gains, each42-group family and additionally the full8x42=336 group family; these are distinct from the global16 family.
bootstrap.physical_group_uncertainty: Within-stratum resampling keeps launched counts fixed but S1 counts random; conditional group means and globally event-weighted means remain coherent.

optimizer_variation.report: Per seed paired global NLL difference; mean, sampleSD, min,max,sign count.
optimizer_variation.limit: Five seeds share training and evaluation data; optimizer spread is not five independent data experiments.
optimizer_variation.event_ci_per_seed: Not required in primary scope; no additional family is silently added.

secondary_old160.report: All160 frozen models, all previously fixed comparisons and seed exceptions, separately C/D; mean/sampleSD/range per existing comparison families.
secondary_old160.bootstrap: No new2000-resample CI family for the160 legacy models.
secondary_old160.role: Descriptive robustness/reference, not substitutes for any new equal-structure80 cell.

group_follow_up.status: Predeclared fresh follow-up of the earlier post-hoc A/B pattern; original A/B analysis remains post-hoc.
group_follow_up.report: All groups, counts, gains, seed spread, prescribed bands, event-weighted reconstruction; do not select negative regions after seeing C/D.
group_follow_up.boundary: Counts of negative group means are neither independent trials nor proof of a regional-failure theorem; event share of negative-mean bins is not the fraction of individual events harmed.

exact_density_decomposition.scope: New80 models; each seed, momentum bin and42 physical group, then arithmetic seed means/spread.
exact_density_decomposition.paired_sign: Raw term minus CorrectedPhysics term, whose sum reconstructs Raw NLL minus CorrectedPhysics NLL.
exact_density_decomposition.numerical_check: Verify log_q_z and log_p_y using float64 aggregation of float32 saved components, atol1e-5 and rtol2e-6; report maximum reconstruction residual.
exact_density_decomposition.boundary: Density-coordinate/Jacobian/support components are not unique location/scale/shape or causal contributions.

operational_diagnostics.residuals: Per representation/fraction use the exact frozen center, mu and scale; report original-unit residual and standardized residual summaries without duplicating identical preprocessor rows as independent seed evidence.
operational_diagnostics.pit_reference: Uniform(0,1) under correct continuous conditional distribution; use stable logCDF/logSF for tails and verify complement.
operational_diagnostics.boundary: Operational summaries are nonorthogonal and group pooling can conceal finer errors. Finite-bin centering may alter pooled spread despite exact-condition variance invariance. No auxiliary model calibration or lambda-center models are added.

source_location_analysis.input: Existing source diagnostic pool only, never C/D; exact split and UID digest bound by analysis manifest.
source_location_analysis.partition: 56 equal-width p bins on[.3,1.0] x6 exact(t,q) strata, a common refinement of7 reporting bins and2/8 conditioner bins.
source_location_analysis.contexts: Compute event-weighted variance of fine-bin means around each retained-condition-cell mean for Hidden5,Coarse2,Coarse8.
source_location_analysis.preprocessing: Use frozen per representation/fraction preprocessing. Globalmu cancels from location differences; identical original-unit rows across fractions are not replication.
source_location_analysis.Full5: Exact p is observed; unobserved-p conditional-mean burden is theoretically0. Do not interpret finite-binRMS as a measured nonzero remaining Full burden.
source_location_analysis.boundary: Binned source-only descriptive approximation to conditional-mean variation, not fresh performance, exact nonlinear approximation error, or a causal likelihood attribution.

practical_effect.definition: exp(Delta) is geometric-mean paired density ratio over events and fixed paired models;100*expm1(Delta) is its percentage change.
practical_effect.example: .0015nat/event corresponds to1.00150112556, approximately.1501126% in geometric mean density ratio.
not_claimed: new equivalence test using historical.02nat margin
practical_effect.cumulative: N*Delta only summarizes cumulative log-score difference for N events; does not establish downstream utility.
practical_effect.interactions: Exponentiating a difference of gains gives a ratio of density ratios, not a direct single-model gain.

validation.synthetic_tests: 9 passed in3.06s; tests/test_information_analysis.py; includes complete80-model adapter, provenance rejection, density accounting, S0 mixture, paired resampling and source56 diagnostics.

completion_policy: No COMPLETE scientific analysis after failed model/data/UID/hash/eligibility/reconstruction gates or deadline. Preserve partial logs and all negative/inconclusive results; never select scope from observed score.
analysis_entrypoint: python -m representation_flow.run_information_analysis {validation,fresh}; explicit paths required for fresh metadata; nonempty output never overwritten.

output_schemas.optimizer_group_variation: group_seed_variation.csv contains all336 new primary groups with five named seed values, mean/sampleSD/range/signs; distinct from event bootstrapSE
output_schemas.density_components: per-seed physical42 and momentum7 groups plus density_component_seed_summary.csv
output_schemas.predictive_diagnostics: PIT/coverage per model physical42 and momentum7 groups; no selection

freeze_authorization: Root approved final statistical freeze after evidence_audit final source/mathematical/API review and9 synthetic tests. No formal C/D data generated or used for this analysis design.
